props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Unmounts the tooltip popup. - `close`: Closes the tooltip imperatively when called.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the tooltip. This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the tooltip is initially open. To render a controlled tooltip, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the tooltip is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open tooltip.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tooltip is disabled.

props.name: disableHoverablePopup
props.description: Whether the tooltip contents can be hovered without closing the tooltip.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the tooltip with a trigger. If specified, allows external triggers to control the tooltip's open state. Can be created with the Tooltip.createHandle() method.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the tooltip is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the tooltip is opened or closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is currently open.

props.name: trackCursorAxis
props.description: Determines which axis the tooltip should track the cursor on.

props.name: triggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the tooltip is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled tooltip. There's no need to specify this prop when the tooltip is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

props.name: container
props.type: HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | RefObject<HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | null> | null
props.description: A parent element to render the portal element into.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment. The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties: - `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against. - `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | …
props.typeFull: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null) | null
props.description: An element to position the popup against. By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup. Use it to prevent the arrow element from hanging out of the rounded corners of a popup.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup. `side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`): - `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side (`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`). - `'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within the clipping boundary so it stays visible. - `'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow. `align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`): - `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows. - `'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the alignment axis to fit. - `'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow. `fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the preferred axis cannot fit: - `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first (`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR). - `'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first (`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR). - `'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis. When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`. If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment. The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties: - `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against. - `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long to wait before closing a tooltip. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before opening the tooltip on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Another tooltip will open instantly if the previous tooltip is closed within this timeout. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long to wait before closing the tooltip. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close when this trigger is clicked.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before opening the tooltip on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If `true`, the tooltip will not open when interacting with this trigger. Note that this doesn't apply the `disabled` attribute to the trigger element. If you want to disable the trigger element itself, you can pass the `disabled` prop to the trigger element via the `render` prop.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a tooltip.

props.name: payload
props.description: A payload to pass to the tooltip when it is opened.
